summary: Out-of-band alpha for CEE 1.2.0 build 132. This is an experimental testing release; WWPG 0.2.10 remains the stable release. Full acceptance has not been completed for this exact alpha.
changes: Prepares WWPG's electrical integration for CEE 1.2.
Fixes CEE wire-tool preview crashes over Power Grid and Power Dock terminals.
Corrects mixed-wire endpoint positions on Sable sublevels, including movement interpolation.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, Java 21, NeoForge 21.1.262, Create 6.0.10, CEE 1.21.1-1.2.0-132, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.12. Replace your WWPG jar; match client/server versions. Set PG multiTicks to 16. Test a copy of your world. Focused checks and client loading passed; in-world sublevel visuals still need confirmation.
optional_installation: Power Dock 0.3.0-preview and Sable 2.0.5 are optional. The combined Stationary Yard also needs CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and Pinout 0.2.1.
